newsitem.title: USA: IBM to sell stake in Diebold venture.
newsitem.headline: IBM to sell stake in Diebold venture.

text.p: Diebold Inc said on Wednesday that International Business Machines Corp has advised the company that it is exercising its option to sell its 30 percent interest in its InterBold venture to Diebold.
InterBold is the seven-year-old joint venture between Diebold and IBM to design and develop automated teller machines (ATMs), Diebold said in a statement.
Diebold and IBM have begun discussions to assess the value of the minority stake, Diebold said.
InterBold announced last week that it has discontinued its international marketing and distribution agreement with IBM, Diebold said.

Diebold is now positioned to be a strong player in the global marketplace, by expanding its sales and marketing resources in Europe, Asia, the Pacific Rim and Central and South America in recent years, the company said.
